from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    top=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v!=0 for v in row)>=3)
    cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v]
    for c in cols:
        color=grid[top][c]
        marks=[(r,j) for r in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[r][j]==color and (r!=top or j not in cols)]
        if marks:
            r,j=marks[0]
            for rr in range(min(top,r),max(top,r)+1): out[rr][c]=color
            for cc in range(min(c,j),max(c,j)+1): out[r][cc]=color
        else:
            for rr in range(h): out[rr][c]=color
    return out
'''
(base/'task-ce14572a.py').write_text(code)
